title: CoreClient
description: Includes debug-only commands, not intended for regular gameplay.
body:
⚠️ Developer Version of CoreClient ⚠️

This mod version includes diagnostic commands such as /client settings killlwjgl, which will crash the game and display a native JNA window. Before the crash, a confirmation GUI appears with two buttons: Confirm Crash — proceeds with the crash, and Cancel — aborts it.

Use these commands strictly for debugging purposes. This feature is not recommended for regular gameplay and is intended only for developers or advanced users.
